name: The South Indian Bank Limited
summary: The South Indian Bank Limited provides various banking products and services in India. It operates through Treasury, Corporate/Wholesale Banking, Retail Banking, and Other Banking Operations segments. The company offers savings, institutional banking, non-resident external, non-resident ordinary, fixed currency non-resident, and current accounts; term deposits; and portfolio investment schemes.
